war_summary: War 139 is on day 99 with no winner yet and 32 victory towns required. The map shows a heavily fragmented front: many regions are fully consolidated by one faction (e.g., Colonials hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale; Wardens hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit), while several contested hexes are seeing intense fighting. The hottest active fronts over the last 24 hours are Oarbreaker (46 base events, heavy back-and-forth at Posterus), Endless Shore (37 events, Colonial push against Warden-held bases), Clahstra (24 events, Colonial offensive into Warden territory), Stlican Shelf (21 events, Warden-held but under Colonial assault), Mooring County (18 events, Borderlane hotspot), and Godcrofts (10 events, mixed ownership). Casualty rates are accelerating sharply in Callahan's Passage, Olavis Wake, Onyx, Marban Hollow, and Speaking Woods, indicating large ongoing battles even where recent capture events are sparse. Quiet rear regions show minimal activity and are unlikely to change hands in the next 24 hours.
